items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I don't know too much of him either.

ctx.x: See if they... Oh, I wouldn't look them up because this guy, Mares... Well, you know, he and Pete... Pete and Al hate each other. There's no question about it, but they get together every now and then and make a buck. But then... And Mares stole the records from them and turned them out. And I don't know the whole story of it. But he's been known for Duda, that Mares guy. Now his brother, the trumpet... Paul. Yeah, Paul. I don't know too much of him either.
I wanted to ask you about these kids that you taught in the Western Union Band. Did any of them grow up to be professionals?
